title: A walk to a building never arrives: the sidestep ladder oscillates beside its unenterable tile, so REST and EAT are almost never dispatched
summary: An entity orthogonally beside an unenterable destination tile (building or blocked tile) now arrives: resolve_move ends the walk instead of sidestepping; REST decisions 0 to 34 in frontier_living_world; eat and sleep unchanged at 0 (action semantics are Lane B); sidestep rung extracted to keep the ratchet clean; divergence 2.78, COMB-336
